description: Implement the fetchInstagramData() function in script.js to actually fetch post data from Instagram using multiple fallback strategies (CORS proxy + page scraping, embed page parsing), and update the poster with fetched data. Also update Playwright tests to verify autofill behavior.
steps: Replace the fetchInstagramData() function in script.js (currently at line ~95) with a real implementation that: (a) Tries fetching via a CORS proxy service (e.g., https://api.codetabs.com/v1/proxy?quest= or similar free services) to get the Instagram page HTML, (b) Parses the HTML response to extract og:image, og:description, and author info from meta tags or embedded JSON data, (c) Falls back to trying the Instagram embed endpoint at https://www.instagram.com/p/{shortcode}/embed/ via CORS proxy to extract data, (d) Returns an object with username, caption, imageUrl, and any other available fields

Ensure the function handles errors gracefully - if all fetch attempts fail, it should still return whatever partial data is available (at minimum the shortcode from the URL) and not throw errors that break the UI flow

Add user feedback in the generatePoster() function to indicate what data was successfully fetched vs what needs manual input - for example, if the image URL was fetched but comments were not, indicate to the user that comments need manual entry

Update the Playwright tests in tests/poster.spec.js to add a test that verifies: when a valid Instagram URL is entered and Generate Poster is clicked, the poster content updates with non-default values (the poster-username element should not still show '@username', or the poster image container should have an img element, or the caption should have changed). Since actual Instagram fetching may fail in CI, the test should mock the fetch response or verify the UI behavior pattern (button states, spinner, and that the function completes without error)

Create a feature branch named 'feature/implement-instagram-fetch', commit all changes, push to origin, and create a PR using 'gh api repos/amirmuntaha/instagram_extractor/pulls' targeting the main branch
acceptance_criteria: The fetchInstagramData() function in script.js attempts to actually fetch data from Instagram (not just extract from URL)
When fetching succeeds, the username, caption, and image URL fields are populated and the poster displays the fetched data
When fetching fails (e.g., CORS blocked, Instagram down), the app degrades gracefully without errors and still shows the poster with whatever data is available
The Playwright tests pass (npx playwright test) including at least one new test that covers the generate/autofill flow
A PR is created on GitHub targeting the main branch
verification: Run 'npx playwright test' and confirm all tests pass
Check that script.js contains a fetchInstagramData function that makes actual HTTP requests (not just URL parsing)
